description: This file contains integration test functions for a backend API, focusing on various security and compliance aspects such as auth, SoD, digital signatures, and evidence integrity. All test functions are marked as expected to fail with reasons indicating unimplemented features.

methods.name: str _todo(reason: str)
methods.description: Helper function to generate consistent and searchable TODO/failure reason strings for unimplemented features.

methods.name: test_integration_auth_missing_token_blocks_write_and_is_auditable()
methods.description: Integration test to verify that missing authentication tokens are rejected and denied attempts are properly audited.

methods.name: test_integration_sod_violation_same_user_submit_and_approve_is_blocked_and_audited()
methods.description: Integration test to ensure that SoD (Segregation of Duties) violations, such as same user submitting and approving, are blocked and recorded.

methods.name: test_integration_esign_invalid_signature_hash_is_rejected_and_no_evidence_created()
methods.description: Integration test to verify invalid signature hashes are rejected and no evidence artifacts are created when signature integrity fails.

methods.name: test_integration_tampered_evidence_checksum_detected_and_flagged()
methods.description: Integration test to detect evidence tampering via checksum mismatch and ensure proper handling and audit logging.
